description: A frozen conversation. Created automatically when a user accumulates blocked attempts against an agent; every further message is refused until a reviewer releases it.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Locked refuses every message on this conversation. Only a reviewer can move it to Released.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The user whose attempts triggered the freeze. They can never release their own lock.

fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: Empty when the freeze was raised before a conversation existed; the user/agent pair is then what is enforced.

fields.label: Reason
fields.options:
Repeated Blocked Attempts
Rate Limit
Manual

fields.label: Blocked Attempts
fields.description: How many blocked attempts were counted in the window when the freeze was raised.

fields.label: Triggering Event
fields.description: The security event that tipped the count over the threshold. The full history is every event for this user and agent in the window.

fields.label: Release Notes
fields.description: Why the reviewer released it. Recorded through the release method, not editable here.

name: AI Conversation Lock
